title: RiskAnalytics
description: V2 Layer-4: the ML block's RISK-ANALYTICS output — forward volatility forecast + market-regime state + suggested sizing per ticker. This is INFORMATION for risk_manager (vol-targeting + regime gating), NOT a directional or trade decision. Produced after the cross-sectional directional alpha was found not to generalize (price and news both closed); the ML block's honest, deployable role is risk analytics.

vol_forecast.description: Predicted forward realized volatility (per-bar, EWMA) over the horizon.

inv_vol_weight.description: Suggested vol-targeting weight (1/vol, normalized to sum 1 over valid tickers).

distance.description: Mahalanobis novelty distance of the current regime vs the past distribution.

novel.description: True if the current regime is in the high-novelty tail (model least reliable).

exposure_scalar.description: Suggested gross-exposure multiplier (1 = normal, 0 = abstain in a novel regime).
